davinci.title: DaVinci Resolve Installation
davinci.body:
DaVinci Resolve requires manual download due to licensing.

1. Go to blackmagicdesign.com and download the Linux version (ZIP).
2. Click Continue to select the downloaded file.
3. We will convert it to a Debian package and install it.
davinci.patchesIntro: DaVinci Resolve is installed. The following optional patches can fix common issues on certain hardware. Select the ones you want to apply:
davinci.micHint: Creates a virtual PipeWire microphone so DaVinci Resolve can start when no physical capture device is present.
davinci.gpuTitle: Integrated GPU patch (AMD / Intel iGPU, mini PCs)
davinci.gpuHint: Installs OpenCL drivers, firmware and patches the launcher so DaVinci Resolve works on integrated AMD or Intel graphics.

vmware.title: VMware Workstation Pro installation
vmware.body:
VMware Workstation Pro requires a manual download for licensing reasons.

1. Go to broadcom.com and download the Linux installer (.bundle).
2. Press Continue to select the downloaded file.
3. We'll install it and set up Soplos's VMware kernel modules (vmmon/vmnet) so they keep working across kernel updates.
vmware.installed: VMware Workstation Pro was installed successfully.
vmware.uninstallOpened: A terminal has opened to uninstall VMware Workstation Pro. Follow the instructions shown there.
vmware.uninstallNoTerminal: Couldn't open Ghostty to uninstall VMware Workstation Pro. Install Ghostty, or uninstall it manually with: sudo vmware-installer --uninstall-product vmware-workstation --console

virtualbox.title: This adds two repositories to your system
virtualbox.body: Installing VirtualBox adds Oracle's own repository, plus Debian's trixie-security repository (needed because a dependency VirtualBox requires is no longer in this system's own suite). Both stay configured permanently after this — Uninstall removes them again. Continuing accepts this.

virtualbox-extension-pack.title: Accept Oracle's license
virtualbox-extension-pack.body: The Extension Pack is distributed under Oracle's Personal Use and Evaluation License (PUEL), separate from VirtualBox's own open-source license. Continuing installs it and accepts that license.

hero.title: Gaming Center
hero.description: Optimizations, launchers and wallpapers for gaming on Soplos Linux.

gaming.lutrisFixDescription: Fixes Lutris GPU detection inside Flatpak's sandbox (user or system) and makes sure vulkan-tools is present for an apt install. Launch Lutris at least once before applying this fix.
gaming.lutrisNotInstalled: Lutris is not installed. Install it first from the Launchers section below.
gaming.wallpapersDescription: Install exclusive gaming wallpapers for your desktop
gaming.wallpapersInstalled: Gaming wallpapers installed. You can now select them from your wallpaper settings.
gaming.wallpapersFailed: Could not install the gaming wallpapers. Check the output above for details.

gamemode.label: GameMode
gamemode.hint: Feral GameMode sets the CPU governor to performance, raises game process priority and notifies the kernel while a game is running.

performance-mode.label: Performance Mode
performance-mode.hint: Installs a wrapper script that switches the CPU to performance mode while a game runs, restoring it on exit. Add 'soplos-game-performance %command%' to Steam launch options.

sysctl.label: Gaming Sysctl
sysctl.hint: Kernel parameter tweaks for gaming: vm.max_map_count for Proton/Steam, lower swappiness, reduced latency.

gpu.label: Optimize GPU
gpu.hint: Detects your GPU (NVIDIA / AMD / Intel) and applies driver-specific performance tweaks. Installs prime-run on hybrid NVIDIA laptops.

disk-io.label: Disk I/O
disk-io.hint: Installs udev rules that assign the best I/O scheduler per disk type (BFQ for HDD, mq-deadline for SSD, none for NVMe).

mangohud.label: MangoHud
mangohud.hint: Installs MangoHud, GOverlay, VulkanInfo, gamescope, DXVK and vkBasalt via Flatpak. Add 'mangohud %command%' to Steam launch options.

cpu-power.label: CPU Power
cpu-power.hint: Installs linux-cpupower and cpupower-gui to control the CPU frequency governor from a graphical interface.

ryzenadj.label: RyzenAdj
ryzenadj.hint: Fixes overheating on AMD Ryzen Mini PCs with proprietary EC firmware by limiting TDP/temperature via the CPU SMU. Compiles from source and installs as a systemd service.
